Employer & your details

PDF appearance

Choose what accounts sees. Date and total hours always appear. These preferences are saved for this employer.

Sync across devices

Your hours live in this browser. Connect a workspace and every device holding the same code keeps the same timesheet — entries merge both ways, so nothing entered on either device is lost.

Paste the same code on your phone or laptop to join. Treat it like a password: anyone holding it can read and write this timesheet.

Sending account

One-click sending posts the PDF to your own send service, which emails it from the sender address below. Leave these blank to keep using the Gmail draft instead.

Automatic submission

Setup pending — automatic sending is not active.
Cloud sync and authorised email sending must be connected first. Closing this browser must not stop scheduled submissions.

Melbourne daylight saving applies automatically. The date override applies only to the week currently open. If the entire week has no entries, use default hours for Monday–Friday. Partial weeks are sent as entered. Default: 6 hours × 5 days = 30 hours.
